prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts consistently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts frequently underpredicted major wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-16.2% and -9.2%).
Redesigning the story stage (choose_path, redesign) consistently improved performance across 2 agreeing winning tests (+7.6% and +5.7%).
Choose path copy changes (choose_path, copy) hurt performance in 2 of 3 tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced inconsistent outcomes, driving both significant wins (+3.3% to +6.8%) and major losses (-4.5% to -9.6%).
Evidence remains thin for categories lacking at least 2 agreeing tests (such as single-test changes, finish layout, and sign-in redesigns).

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Story Scroll Redesign: Redesign the initial story onboarding screen into a smooth vertical story scroll layout with playful pet teaser animations. (why: Lessons from earlier weeks show story screen redesigns consistently drove wins (+7.6% and +5.7%), helping lift initial funnel momentum.)
1: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Two Column Layout: Reorganize the sign-in screen into a side-by-side two-column layout highlighting cloud pet account backup on the left. (why: Support mail logged 8 complaints about pets missing or reset after re-signing in, while sign_in stage has an 86.4% conversion rate.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Personality Trait Preview Sub-Flow: Insert a trait preview step within adoption to let users preview companion behaviors before finalizing adoption. (why: 3 support emails reported issues or confusion during pet creation, and adoption step drops 21.2% of users.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Launch Dock Info: Display explicit status info on the waiting screen explaining how the pet anchors to the OS desktop dock upon completion. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted pets not showing on desktop or apps failing to open, while the home step has a median duration of 201s.)
4: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Full Bleed Preview Redesign: Redesign the generation wait screen into a full-bleed visual canvas showing live pet initialization rendering. (why: The waiting step (home stage) has a mean duration of 2336s and 86.3% completion rate; immersive rendering keeps users from abandoning.)
5: [finish, layout] Home Intro Full Bleed Stage Layout: Switch the final welcome screen layout to full-bleed stage mode with prominent system tray control hints. (why: Finish conversion drops to 68.0% (lowest in funnel) with median 395s, and 3 support emails asked how to control or hide the desktop pet.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Cloud Account Continuity Hint: Add an explicit safeguard hint explaining that sign-in locks companion traits safely to your cloud account profile. (why: 8 support emails (largest single theme) reported missing or reset pets after signing back into their account.)
7: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Companion Launch Headline: Update final screen headline and primary action label to directly guide users on how to trigger their first pet interaction on desktop. (why: Finish stage drops to 68.0%, and support requests show users are confused about how to talk to or control their pet after finishing onboarding.)
